choice: This increment may implement only a private, pure F15 provider projection helper. It must not construct ProgrammeOutputBinding until a trusted ValidatedEncodingPlan is available.
reason: PreparedJobInput binds programme and input data. resolve_selected_profile checks only the supported six-dimensional profile. Neither proves selected provider-set validation or complete encode-plan identity.
plan_producer: Trusted programme parent after selected provider receipts and full EncodingProfile/carriage have been validated. Bind ProgrammeId, resource SHA, config SHA, N, all six profile dimensions, carriage, approved package/F15 provider manifest identities, and the selected provider validation lineages.
existing_receipts: PreparedJobInput is produced by input preparation. ResolvedEncodingProfile is produced by resolve_selected_profile. Individual provider receipts remain owned by their validators/stages. The implementation reports no aggregate ValidatedEncodingPlan type today; do not synthesize one from caller strings. Parent may add one minimal private aggregate that contains actual typed identities/receipts.
f15_helper: The helper accepts the private validated plan/admission token and derives the sealed F15 output policy object. The emitted OutputProvider is not an independent input to bind_output. If the plan token does not exist, helper may be defined privately but production binding stays unavailable.

profile_namespaces.relationship: distinct identifiers; the parent plan binds both plus carriage

provider_sha_semantics: SHA-256 over the canonical UTF-8 JSON provider projection in the existing F15 projection package. The plan must carry and compare this exact derived SHA; caller-supplied hash/profile cannot select policy.

derived_fields.counts: Q=ceil(N/1536); source_count=Q+2; published_aus=Q; product_bytes=Q*4096, checked arithmetic. These dynamic values do not enter the provider hash.

pre_call_reject: F15 provider manifest or required typed provider receipt mismatch
fixture_boundary: OUTPUT-OWNER-ROOT-V1 is test-only (production_allowed=false). Its test provider/IO evidence is not promoted. The F15 projection package defines the Wash local policy bytes; it is not a native fact.
runtime_status: No implementation, GTC root commit, filesystem operation or whole-programme run was verified in this wash step.
